objective: Prove bounded deterministic adaptive replanning: explicit failure/blocker triggers create a new archived generation, stale triggers and cycles fail closed, invalidated M014 reuse blocks downstream scheduling, and the M013 scheduler only ever sees the latest validated generation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Producer completes with exact attested evidence

nodes.title: Consumer of the reusable upstream proof

acceptance_criteria.statement: Consumer consumes only proven upstream evidence
